interventions.detail: Used Python 3.11 instead of README's 3.7.0 (unavailable; torch>=2.6 requires >=3.9)
Replaced numpy==1.15.4/scipy==1.1.0 (won't build on modern Python, conflict with torch>=2.6) with numpy==1.26.4, scipy==1.13.1
Pinned nibabel==4.0.2 since nibabel>=5 removed get_data() used in datasets/brains18.py
Installed CPU-only torch==2.6.0 wheel from the PyTorch CPU index instead of README's CUDA 9.0 setup
requirements.txt is internally inconsistent (torch>=2.6.0 alongside 2018-era numpy/scipy pins) and README PyTorch-0.4.1 contradicts it
